patch.summary:
Choose Dext only if your buying job matches “Bookkeeping and receipt automation for accountants and small businesses — affiliate partne” rather than Jibble's shape. Choose Jibble only if your buying job matches “Time & attendance with free forever unlimited users (GPS, face recognition, timesheets) — ” rather than Dext's shape. Workflow advantage: Dext leans bookkeeping-automation; Jibble leans time-attendance, frontline-ops. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Dext is Bookkeeping and receipt automation for accountants and small businesses — affiliate partner.; Jibble is Time & attendance with free forever unlimited users (GPS, face recognition, timesheets) — paid Premium ~$4.49 and Ultimate ~$7.99/user/mo an.
- Workflow coverage skew: Dext-leaning bookkeeping-automation vs Jibble-leaning time-attendance, frontline-ops.
